name: HTS_SCHED_EVENTS
description: Table to store schedule events during import schedule process

columns.name: SCHED_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Primary Key column containing a random generated number.  This column is not updateable.

columns.name: SCHED_REQUEST_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifier of the request as specified by the exporter

columns.name: SCHED_EVENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifier of the schedule event as specified by the exporter

columns.name: SCHED_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: SCHED_REQUEST_ID

columns.name: RESOURCE_REF
columns.description: The resource reference that matches the specified resource reference type.

columns.name: RESOURCE_REF_TYPE
columns.description: Resource reference type. For now,  4 possible values: Assignment id, Assignment Number, Person Id, Person Number.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: RESOURCE_ID

columns.name: RESOURCE_ASSIGN_ID
columns.description: RESOURCE_ASSIGN_ID

columns.name: IMPORT_MODE
columns.description: Import mode. Values are FULL or  UPDATE.

columns.name: PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: The period start date of the schedule that is imported

columns.name: PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.description: The period end date of the schedule that is imported

columns.name: PUBLISH
columns.description: Specify whether to publish the imported schedules. Values are Y or N.

columns.name: ALLOW_EDITS
columns.description:
Specify whether the schedule that is imported can be edited by the scheduler in
the application, on the Manage Planned Schedule page. Values are Y or N.

columns.name: WORKER_NOTIF
columns.description: Specify whether to notify workers after publishing their schedules. Values are Y or N.

columns.name: STATUS_IMP
columns.description: Status for the import phase

columns.name: STATUS_INT
columns.description: Status for the internalization phase

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: ENTERPRISE_ID

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.description: GROUP_ID

columns.name: MASTER_JOB_ID
columns.description: MASTER_JOB_ID

columns.name: SLAVE_JOB_ID
columns.description: SLAVE_JOB_ID
